# Frontend task review template

Status: TEMPLATE — not a review or acceptance record.

Record review date, reviewer, source commit/tree, contract digest, dataset/case, build manifest, builder and browser identities. State whether you rebuilt independently and disclose limitations.

For both desktop and phone, record task, source/record/reference IDs, actions through the product UI, observed results, supplied coverage limits and restored navigation/focus. For citations record snapshot/artifact/revision/range identities and pinned-link reopening. Separate receipt stages and reported outcomes from inferred benefit.

Record each finding with severity, exact steps, expected/actual behavior and screenshot references. List checks not performed. State disposition and its scope: frontend fixture acceptance, changes requested, or blocked. Backend contract adoption and live integration remain separate.

Corrections: name the correction commit and actual rebuilt output, re-check each finding, record new failures and append the disposition without rewriting the original review.
